title: Cyrus and the Room
author: Paloma Zhou
blurb: Freya Eriksen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
